question: What are the main risk factors Boeing lists about the 737 MAX in FY2022?
answer: Boeing faces several risk factors concerning the 737 MAX, including uncertainty over the timing of delivery resumptions in China subject to final regulatory approvals [Boeing FY22 p.12], debt increases driven by the 737 MAX grounding [Boeing FY22 p.18], and operational and supply chain challenges in stabilizing production at 31 per month [Boeing FY22 p.9]. Furthermore, the company must incorporate safety enhancements into new 737 MAX aircraft and retrofit previously delivered ones [Boeing FY22 p.9], while navigating increased global regulatory scrutiny following prior 737 MAX accidents [Boeing FY22 p.36].
